sections.brief: Minimum wage over time: US federal $3.10 (1980) to $7.25 (2009, unchanged as of Oct 2026; EPI real value 42% below 1968), state minima 2026 (avg $11.51, 20 states at $7.25); Israel's 1987 law (47.5% of average wage), NII series 1997–2026 (NIS 2,348.88 → 6,443.85; freeze at 5,300 2017–22; WageIndicator date error corrected), Taub 2010 min-to-median 58% vs US 34%; OECD hours 1990–2025 (Israel 2,033→1,870, US 1,832→1,800; HiveDesk ranking corrected); leave law (no US federal paid vacation; Israel 10→12 days 2017); gender pay gap (US 19.0%→17.3% weekly; Israel 23.1% monthly, Shoresh; OECD avg 10.1%). Figures: compare; stats; compare

Histadrut 1920–2026 (Hevrat HaOvdim, Clalit, ~85% of wage earners 1983, 1985 wage pact, 1994 Labour loss and 1995 health law, 1.8m → ~200,000, 27% density 2016, OECD 2017 coverage 20–30%); US NLRA firm-level bargaining, right-to-work (26 states, Michigan repeal 2024), BLS density 20.1% (1983) → 10.0% (2025), private 5.9%, public 32.9%, coverage 11.2%, union/nonunion earnings; political general strikes 2012, March 2023, 2 Sept 2024. Figures: compare; time

Palestinian workers: 35–40% worked in Israel 1967–90, permits since early 1990s, Gaza permits revoked 10 Oct 2023; PCBS West Bank workers ~172,000 → ~25,000 (Q4 2023) → ~51,000 (Q4 2025), unemployment 13% → 28%; competing counts (+972); foreign workers (quotas, employer-tied visas, 3.3% quota May 2024, PIBA 227,044 permits 2025, Kav LaOved ~270,000, underpayment); US 8.3m unauthorised workers (Pew 2022) and underpayment through fear of deportation; the unequal comparison stated. Figures: stats; compare
